_about: Prices that a site publishes only as an image. Each entry is a reading of ONE image file, tied to its sha256. Every run downloads the image again: same sha256 -> the reading still holds and is emitted; different sha256 -> nothing is emitted for it and the run reports image_changed so an officer reads the new image and updates this file (values, sha256, read_on, read_by). OCR (tesseract) is only a cross-check, never the source: on 2026-10-29 it misread 125.00 as 495.00 and 185.00 as 1485.00 on the sea-cargo card.

pinas_cargo.read_by: Read from the image during setup (Claude Code session); tesseract cross-check agreed on all 6 rate values; the site's own alt text states 'AED 465' and 'AED 15 per kg'. To be confirmed once by the officer.
